programme.title: South Park: Muscle Plus 4000

programme.title: South Park: Un éléphant fait l'amour avec un cochon
programme.desc: Les enfants cherchent à faire un croisement entre un éléphant et un cochon de lait.
programme.sub-title: Un éléphant fait l'amour avec un cochon

programme.title: South Park: La Mort
programme.desc: Marvin Marsh, le grand-père de Stan, veut absolument mourir. Il demande à son petit-fils de l'aider.

programme.title: South Park: Conjonctivite Aiguë
programme.desc: Kenny meurt. À la morgue, les croque-morts se servent d'une sauce comme liquide d'embaumement.

programme.title: South Park: Damien
programme.desc: Damien, le fils de Satan arrive à South Park où son père et Jesus s'apprêtent à livrer bataille.

programme.title: South Park: Le Petit Etherniopien
programme.desc: Pensant recevoir une montre à quartz, les enfants envoient cinq dollars en Éthiopie mais ils reçoivent en fait un enfant du pays.

programme.title: South Park: Monsieur Hankey, le petit caca Noël

programme.sub-title: Monsieur Hankey, le petit caca Noël

programme.title: South Park: Chirurgie Esthétique
programme.desc: M. Garrison doit subir une rhinoplastie et se fait remplacer par la sulfureuse Mlle Ellen.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Barbara Streisand cherche à former le diamant de Panthéos pour revêtir sa forme ultime, Mecha Streisand, et détruire South Park.

programme.title: South Park: La mère de Cartman est une folle du cul

programme.sub-title: La mère de Cartman est une folle du cul

programme.sub-title: La mère de Cartman est toujours une folle du cul

programme.title: South Park: Le Charmeur de poules

programme.title: South Park: Le Zizi de Ike

programme.sub-title: La grenouille mexicaine hypnotique du sud du Sri Lanka

programme.sub-title: Les Boulettes du Chef au Chocolat Salé

programme.sub-title: Roger Ebert Devrait Manger moins de Gras

programme.title: South Park: Les Journées Vaches
programme.desc: C'est la fête de la vache à South Park. La programmation inclut rodéo et fête foraine.

programme.title: One Piece

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy’s battle with Lucci reveals the powerful secrets of the rubber man’s second gear, and the Spandam’s thoughtless Buster Call begins with a brutal barrage of cannonballs.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: When an ancient tree is stolen by a madman with the power to freeze time, Luffy, Usopp, and Sanji track down the culprit in an attempt to save a village’s annual festival!
programme.sub-title: Boss luffy is the culprit? Track down the missing great cherry tree!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami, Sanji, Usopp, Zoro, and company find themselves trapped in a tunnel filled with rapidly rising water. Meanwhile, Luffy musters the strength for one last stand in his battle with Lucci.
programme.sub-title: I can't protect anyone unless i win! Third gear activated!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Flashback to the dark past of Rob Lucci as the young boy learns to dispense a cold, cruel, and brutal brand of justice. Back in real time, Luffy’s battle with Lucci threatens to destroy the navy fleet.
programme.sub-title: Shivering past! Dark justice and rob lucci!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy’s gigantic attack on Lucci takes a devastating toll on his body, Robin rejoins the fight, and the rest of the Straw Hats struggle to survive underwater!
programme.sub-title: A mysterious mermaid appears? As consciousness fades away…

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Thanks to a little help from what appears to be a mermaid, the Straw Hats find themselves reunited aboard an escape vessel, but the fate of Luffy and the Franky Family is yet to be determined!
programme.sub-title: Cannon fire sinks the island! Franky's lamentation!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy pushes his body to the breaking point in his battle with Lucci, and the rest of the Straw Hats try to fight off a fleet of Marines until their captain returns – if he ever does.
programme.sub-title: Wait for luffy! Mortal combat on the bridge of hesitation!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy lies battered and badly beaten, but Usopp’s desperate pleas inspire the rubber-man to mount one final, furious attack on Rob Lucci!
programme.sub-title: Fists full of emotion! Luffy unleashes gatling with all his might!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With their leader crippled by exhaustion and their escape ship destroyed, the Straw Hats find themselves with only one treacherous option: throwing themselves into the sea!
programme.sub-title: From the sea, a friend arrives! The straw hats share the strongest bond!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats are rescued by the unexpected arrival of a dear old friend, but they’ll have to avoid a barrage of deadly cannonballs in order to survive!
programme.sub-title: Everyone makes a great escape! The road to victory is for the pirates!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats bid a tearful farewell to the brave little ship that was their home for so very many adventures. Rest in peace, Merry!
programme.sub-title: Thank you, merry! Snow falls over the parting sea!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats get some much needed rest and relaxation, Franky makes a big announcement, and Vice Admiral Garp tracks down his grandson!
programme.sub-title: Peace interrupted! A navy vice admiral with a fist of love!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy’s friends are shocked to learn that his grandpa is a marine hero, but that’s nothing compared to how surprised they’ll be by his father’s true identity!
programme.sub-title: The strongest family? Luffy's father revealed!

programme.desc: Luffy gets the chance to catch up with his old friend Coby, Nami does some serious snooping, and Robin is paid a chilling visit from a terrifying face from her past.
programme.sub-title: Its name is the new world! The fate of the grand line!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Chopper risk their lives to help a heartbroken young girl track down her long lost pet!
programme.sub-title: A girl in search of her yagara! Great search in the city of water!

programme.sub-title: Mothers are strong! Zoro's hectic household chores!

programme.sub-title: Sanji's shock! Mysterious old man and his super yummy cooking!

programme.title: One Piece

programme.sub-title: The king of animals that overlooks the sea! The dream ship magnificently completed!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: What Happens Next?: What comes after "The End"? Dora and Boots are finishing a fairy tale, and reach the end of the story. They wonder what happens next.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Rescue, Rescue, Rescue: Oh no! Three of our friends are in trouble. Baby Jaguar is stuck in a tree, Isa is stuck in a big sand hole, and Benny is stuck in his balloon on top of the Gooey Geyser. Who do we have to rescue first?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boot's Cuddly Dinosaur: It's bedtime, and Dora and Boots are having a sleepover. Dora has her teddy bear, Osito, but Boots can't find his cuddly dinosaur. Oh no! His dinosaur must have fallen out of his bag at Play Park.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Super Silly Fiesta: Bawk! It's fiesta time! Dora and Boots are invited to the Big Red Chicken's Super Silly Fiesta! There will be silly snacks, silly games, silly hats and even silly dancing.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Fix-It Machine: Uh oh! Boots has a hole - un hoyo - in his boot! But Dora knows what to do. They can go to the Super Duper Fix-It Machine to fix it right up!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Baseball Boots: Boots loves baseball. He loves to run and catch and throw, but so far he's never gotten a hit. Boots is determined to get his first hit. Dora and Boots have a big baseball game today.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Happy Best Friends Day! Today's a special day for best friends to play together. Boots and Dora decide to meet for a picnic to celebrate. Boots is bringing chocolate; Dora is bringing yummy strawberries.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: A is for armadillo, but where are the rest of the animals in the ABC book? They're missing! Dora and Boots jump into the giant alphabet book to help the little armadillo solve the mystery.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: What do you want to be when you grow up? On today's adventure, Dora and Boots get to try all sorts of jobs - from a pilot to a chef to an archeologist. But what will Dora decide to be when she grows up?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Excited, Dora puts the Star Pocket on Backpack and Dora and Boots set off on their very first star catching adventure. Their educational journey will take them all the way to the Cloud Castle, as they try to rescue an adorable baby star.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora tells the story of how she first met Boots. On their very first adventure, Dora and Boots have to bring instruments back to the Fiesta Trio so they can play for the cranky Queen Bee.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Swiper swipes Dora's favorite necklace and flings it all the way to the top of Star Mountain! To get to the peak, Dora and Boots need to run up the Star Steps, climb up the Diamond, and make it through ice, wind, and snow!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: "Hola, hola!/ Hello, Hello!/ It's a great day for school/ You know!" Boots' music teacher, la maestra de música, needs to get to school in a hurry - but her bicycle is broken!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: It's Dora's cousin Daisy's 15th birthday party, her quinceañera! But the party can't start without Dora and Boots - they need to teach everybody the mambo!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's cousin Diego protects and defends all the animals in the rainforest. But in order to save a Baby Condor, Diego winds up trapped himself. And now he needs OUR help! ¡No te preocupes, Diego!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Oh no! Baby Jaguar's best friend, Baby Bear, is stuck on a ledge atop Bear Mountain - and the ledge is cracking! With Baby Jaguar leading the way, Dora, Boots, and Diego race to the rescue!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots set out to help King Juan el Bobo find his crown so we can all go to his Mamí's birthday party. Where did the forgetful king put his crown?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Abuela gives Dora and Boots a present for Dora's new puppy, but they'll have to watch out for Swiper, who's got a bunch of new swiping tricks up his sleeves.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora has some really exciting news to tell us: Someone new is joining Dora's family! Someone who sleeps in a cradle, drinks from a bottle, wears diapers and likes to be rocked to sleep. Can you guess who it is? That's right!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Oh, no! Dora left her music homework in Boots' room. It's a song in English and Spanish, and she needs Boots to bring it to her school so she can sing it to the class.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's baby brother and sister just love bananas, but they also love stories! So Dora tells them a Super Babies story! The Super Babies have to get their bananas back from that Super Villain Swiper the Fox.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and all her friends are at the Super Adventure Race! To win the race, they have to make it across the Troll's tricky Bridge, past the Volcano filled with gooey balls, over the giant wall, and all the way to the finish line.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: It's summertime, and Dora and Boots are having a blast at the beach. But suddenly, they encounter the strangest sight - a snowman in Summer? What's wrong with this picture? Oh, no!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are hiking on Rainbow Rock when they come across a shy rainbow, Arco Iris, hiding behind a waterfall.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are having a blast at the beach when all of a sudden they hear a call for help. It's a baby crab stuck in a net!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are playing catch when they discover a lost Baby Fox. And he wants his mommy! Just then, Swiper shows up to swipe Boots' superball.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's twin brother and sister have been sick and she wants to buy them a present to cheer them up. Way up on a toy store shelf, she finds a dusty Jack-in-the-Box.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: It's Twins Day and everyone's getting ready for the big Twins Day Party at Play Park! Dora even has a surprise for her puppy Perrito. He has a twin too -- a long-lost puppy brother he hasn't seen since they were babies.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: "Happy Three Kings Day!" Dora, Boots, and Diego are dressed up as kings for the big Three Kings Day party. They'll be bringing a horse, a camel, and an elephant to carry the presents, and treats for the party, but Swiper scares the animals away!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Isa are planting Isa's special unicorn flowers when suddenly a baby unicorn, Unicornio, rides in on a Rainbow. He's thrilled to see Isa's beautiful flowers because they're his Mami's favorite.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Benny is so excited – it's his first time in the Big Go-Cart Race, where everyone races in homemade go-carts! But when the whistle blows, Benny's cart backfires and falls to pieces. But Dora and Boots won't let him give up.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boots and Tico are really excited because it's their first day of school ever -- and in their new school, they'll learn in English and Spanish!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Backpack, Backpack, yeah!!! Today's the Backpack Parade, where everyone dresses up their backpacks in different costumes. Backpack is super excited 'cause this year she gets to lead the parade with her song.

programme.desc: After an unfortunate "glue" accident, the Turtles have to fight a whole host of villains. The Turtles' first public musical gig is interrupted by Albearto and his animatronic army.

programme.desc: Donnie's new A.I. invention takes over the Lair and life isn't all pizza and backrubs for Raph, Mikey and Leo. Mikey goes on a solo mission to retrieve a classic Lou Jitsu video game.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Baron Draxum assembles a league of villains to defeat the Turtles.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: In their underground lair deep beneath the city streets, the Turtles and Master Splinter are suddenly attacked by a horde of Mouser robots! These mechanical menaces chomp through stone, steel, and even Turtles.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Turtles discover the source of the Mouser robots that trashed their old lair: Dr. Baxter Stockman -- a noted technological genius/inventor, who tries to pass off the Mousers as a means to eradicate the city's rat problem.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When April O'Neil wakes up in the Turtle's lair she has major trouble dealing with the reality of four giant talking Turtles and a Zen-master rat, but she calms down when she hears the official ORIGIN of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Raphael is a little cooped up underground with only his brothers and Master Splinter. When Raphael almost clobbers Michelangelo in some brotherly sparring, it's pretty apparent that Raphael needs to get out … let off a little steam.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When a scientist accidentally unleashes a super-powered Nanotech monster with a childlike mind, it adopts a small-time grifter as its father figure, and the mayhem begins!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Turtles, investigating a strange blackout, discover the Foot Ninja stealing a Japanese ceremonial sword from the Metropolitan Museum of Art. The sword turns out to have incredible powers -- able to create powerful vibrational shockwaves.
programme.sub-title: Darkness on the Edge of Town

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: After Casey Jones makes himself an unwanted guest in the Turtles' lair, Raphael takes him topside for a "breath of fresh air", where they encounter the Foot Tech Ninjas - enhanced with cyber armor.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: On a nightly training run, the Turtles and Casey Jones break up a Purple Dragon robbery. One of the perps is Angel, a girl Casey knows from the neighborhood who's going through her initiation rites to become a Purple Dragon.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The boys have made friends with a group of homeless, and are worried when they start mysteriously disappearing into the night! Some Turtle-style detective work leads them to the Garbageman.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Oroku Saki (aka the Shredder) attempts to convince Leonardo that Saki is fighting the good fight … that he's out there carrying on the great tradition of Bushido and Ninjitsu, and the turtles should stand with him.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Unconvincing Turtle Titan: Believing the Turtles can accomplish so much more for the city, and inspired by iconic superhero Silver Sentry, Michelangelo decides to take a crack at being a superhero.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Notes From The Underground Part 1: When Don's examination of some mysterious crystals attracts the attention of a subterranean monster, the Turtles underground exploration unearths a Foot Genetics Lab!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Notes From The Underground Part 2: After discovering an abandoned underground Foot Genetics Lab, and being attacked by once-human Digging Creatures, the Turtles assist those very creatures in trying to repair a Force Field.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'ennemi de mon ennemi
programme.desc: Après avoir vu les Krangs à l'œuvre, Karai propose une alliance aux tortues. Mais est-elle digne de confiance ?

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La mission de Karaï
programme.desc: Le clan des Foot tente de capturer April, qui doit combattre Karaï si elle veut leur échapper.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le retour du Pulvériseur
programme.desc: Quand Shredder projette de créer une armée de mutants, les tortues demandent l'aide de leur plus grand fan.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'œuf
programme.desc: Leonardo, Raphael et Donatello deviennent les esclaves d'une guêpe mutante. Leur sort dépend de leur frère Michelangelo.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une évasion à haut risque
programme.desc: April reçoit un message codé. Pendant que ses frères dorment, Donatello tente de le déchiffrer. C'est Kirby O'Neil, le père d'April, qui appelle à l'aide...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'affrontement, 1ère partie
programme.desc: Les Krangs s'apprêtent à lancer la phase finale de l'invasion de la Terre. Ils préparent l'arrivée du Technodrome depuis la dimension X, qui se fera par le portail.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'affrontement, 2e partie
programme.desc: Leonardo a survécu à l'explosion du dernier étage du TCRI, mais n'a pu empêcher le passage du Technodrome par le portail. L'immense vaisseau en forme de sphère sème la terreur sur la ville, en tirant à vue et enlevant des humains...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mutation accidentelle
programme.desc: C'est la fête chez les Tortues Ninja, mais malheureusement, ça ne va pas durer longtemps ! Les tortues ont répandu accidentellement une cargaison de tubes de mutagène au-dessus de la ville.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Qui est le chef ?
programme.desc: Les tortues parcourent la ville à la recherche des tubes de mutagène grâce au détecteur de fluides de Donnie. Karai repère leur manège et décide de leur tendre un piège...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion des écureuils-mutants
programme.desc: Tandis qu'elles parcourent la ville à la recherche de tubes de mutagène, les tortues tombent sur un sans-abri au comportement étrange. Il est aux prises avec un écureuil très agressif, qui finit par se faufiler dans son estomac...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mutagène-man se déchaîne
programme.desc: Pendant que ses frères regardent un dessin animé débile sur une vieille cassette vidéo, Donatello se confie à Timothy, transformé en mutant et conservé dans un tube dans son labo.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'acné mutante de Mikey
programme.desc: Un beau matin, Mikey se réveille avec des boutons sur tout le corps, ou presque. Pris de panique, il va voir ses frères qui tentent de le rassurer. En retour, il avoue avoir saupoudré un dérivé de mutagène sur sa peau pour devenir plus cool...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une cible nommée April O'Neil
programme.desc: Shredder a eu vent du comportement de Karaï durant son absence et lui ordonne de ne plus s'allier aux Krangs. Mais ces derniers ont fabriqué le successeur des Foot-bots, et Karaï veut absolument se le procurer afin d'éliminer April...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Slash la tortue
programme.desc: Raphael s'agace. Il n'en peut plus d'avoir des frères qui passent leur temps à plaisanter et à jouer, ou à faire des gaffes. Cette fois, l'une des expériences de Donnie tourne mal, et Spike manque d'y laisser sa carapace...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La conspiration des Krangs
programme.desc: Pendant leur entraînement quotidien, les tortues et April se sentent observées. Elles poursuivent l'espion jusqu'à sa cachette, afin de le démasquer. Il s'agit d'un dénommé Kurtzman, journaliste de son métier, qui enquête sur la conspiration des Krangs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le bon, la brute et Casey Jones
programme.desc: Après s'être disputé avec ses frères, Raphael va prendre l'air pour évacuer sa colère.
programme.sub-title: Le bon, la brute et Casey Jones

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Fungus Monstruosus
programme.desc: Les tortues ninja découvrent d'étranges champignons dans les égoûts de New York. Ce sont des champignons mutants, qui ont avalé du mutagène.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête d'acier Version 2.0
programme.desc: Donatello pense avoir réparé et amélioré Tête d'Acier, mais le robot continue d'avoir des bugs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Des rats et des hommes
programme.desc: Le Roi des Rats a créé un sérum de croissance au mutagène qu'il a injecté à ses rats. Ceux-ci enlèvent des humains, destinés à devenir une armée d'hommes-rats. Casey et Irma, une amie d'April, sont kidnappés et enfermés dans des cages dans les égoûts

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tremblement de ver ! - Partie 1
programme.desc: Tandis que les tortues combattent Karaï et les Foot, Leonardo tente de révéler à Karaï la vraie identité de son père, mais en vain. La terre tremble, et elle en profite pour s'éclipser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tremblement de ver ! - Partie 2
programme.desc: Tandis que les tortues combattent Karaï et les Foot, Leonardo tente de révéler à Karaï la vraie identité de son père, mais en vain. La terre tremble, et elle en profite pour s'éclipser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les mutants du labyrinthe
programme.desc: Les quatre frères se passionnent pour un jeu de rôles, et décident de se déguiser pour faire une partie « grandeur nature » dans les égoûts.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman
programme.desc: Shredder met sa menace à exécution et fait exploser le collier de mutagène de Baxter Stockman, toujours incapable de lui fournir une armée de mutants digne de ce nom. Stockman mute en mouche et devient Stockman la mouche.
programme.sub-title: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le retour du Tritonateur
programme.desc: Raph trouve que son partenaire Casey n'est pas à la hauteur. De mystérieux justiciers éliminent les Krangs : il s'agit de Slash, l'ex-tortue Spike de Raph et du Tritonateur.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La colère de Tiger Claw
programme.desc: Shredder confie à Tiger Claw la mission de détruire les tortues. Karai doit leur tendre un piège. Elle réussit à convaincre April qu'elle est du côté des tortues.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête de pizza
programme.desc: Changement de propriétaire chez Antonio, le roi des pizzas. Le nouveau chef est un mutant, à tête de pizza. Tous les clients qui consomment ses créations sont changés en zombies, destinés à finir roulés en calzone dans l'estomac du mutant.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La légende du Kuro Kabuto
programme.desc: Steranko, un obscur marchand d'armes borgne, est à la recherche d'un objet qui viendra compléter sa collection d'armures. Il s'agit du « Kuro Kabuto », le casque de Shredder.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Plan 10
programme.desc: Les Krangs testent une nouvelle machine pour envahir la Terre, qui consiste à permuter les cerveaux. Ils pourront ainsi manœuvrer les leaders terriens et parvenir à leurs fins.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le goût de la vengeance
programme.desc: Karai est enfermée dans les prisons de Shredder. Les tortues la font évader et la ramènent au repaire. Splinter lui explique l'histoire de la guerre entre le Clan des Foot et la famille Hamato.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le fantôme de Chinatown
programme.desc: Pendant qu'ils cherchent Karaï, les tortues croisent les Dragons Pourpres qui paraissent beaucoup plus forts qu'à l'accoutumée. En effet, un mystérieux esprit sorti d'une dague les a dotés de pouvoirs. L'un maîtrise la foudre ; l'autre, le tonnerre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Voyage dans la Dimension X
programme.desc: En voulant trouver une source d'énergie pour sa Tortue Mécha, Donnie ouvre un portail vers la dimension X. Il capte alors un message de Leatherhead, qui est prisonnier des Krangs. Celui-ci l'informe que les Krangs ont perfectionné le mutagène.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion - partie 1
programme.desc: Les tortues n'ont toujours pas retrouvé Karaï. L'inquiétude atteint son paroxysme lorsque Splinter leur annonce que l'invasion des Krangs est imminente. Dans la ville, April et Irma sont poursuivies par des Footbots.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion - partie 2
programme.desc: Suite du premier épisode. Léo se bat contre les acolytes de Shredder et affronte successivement les Footbots, Tiger Claw et Fishface. Puis Shredder porte le dernier coup et fendille sa carapace. Le père d'April est « krang-formé ».

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Après l'invasion de New York, April, Casey et les tortues trouvent refuge dans la maison de campagne de la famille O'Neil. Trois mois ont passé et Leonardo est toujours inconscient.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Raphael organise une partie de cache-cache dans la forêt pour que Mikey et Donnie apprivoisent leur nouvel environnement. Mais ils tombent nez-à-nez avec une créature légendaire, le Big Foot.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Lors d'un grand nettoyage dans la maison de campagne, April et les tortues découvrent un vaisseau Krang caché dans la cave. La mère d'April y était conservée en hibernation.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Mikey a encore tout saccagé dans le salon en rejouant une scène de Crognard le Barbare. Ses frères lui passent un savon et le forcent à nettoyer, ce qui le pousse à s'enfuir dans la forêt.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.desc: Alberto discovers he has a natural talent for golf and begins to compete, but will his dad's embarrassing cheers make him give it up? Buster has lost his flair for funny, and the harder he tries to make people laugh, the worse it gets.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur and Buster have always been best friends, but when a leaky roof forces Arthur to study in Buster's room, they discover that they make better friends than roommates. Arthur's ecstatic when he wins free concert tickets on the radio.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Arthur catches Buster sucking his thumb, Buster worries that Arthur will tell the entire school. Tired of doing chores, Arthur and friends decide to invent their own country. Will this kid-ruled utopia flourish or descend into anarchy?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The local creek is polluted and pesticide run-off is to blame. Francine is determined to get the word out at the annual Earth Day rally. Ladonna can't wait to experience her first blizzard, if only the weather would cooperate.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: There's a mouse loose in the Read home! And D.W. wants it gone…NOW! When traps fail, Arthur enlists the help of an expert mouse catcher. While playing in the park, Binky, Muffy, and Ladonna stumble upon an abandoned kite.
programme.sub-title: Pets and Pests/Go Fly a Kite

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: After meeting his hero, Hollywood director Tufton Sinclair, George is inspired to make a movie of his own. When George accidentally breaks the class's prize woodworking project, Binky gets unfairly blamed.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Muffy is thrilled when mega producer J3 chooses her family for his latest reality TV project. After all, she was born to be star! Buster has just won the best young artist award at the Elwood City Arts Festival.

programme.title: Arthur

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Bud is blamed for an accident D.W. causes, she has to decide whether to let her friend take the fall. D.W. and Bud can't wait to ride a new rollercoaster. Will they make it past the ticket taker, or will they come up short?
programme.sub-title: The Tattletale Frog/D.W. & Bud's Higher Purpose

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Muffy embarks on a quest to find her long lost imaginary friend. And then it's Catherine's 16th birthday, and Francine has been cordially UN-invited to the party.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Fern's been feeling low and no one can figure out why. Luckily, Buster Baxter is on the case! With Arthur out of town, Buster is on the hunt for a new best friend, but he only wants to play games HIS way. Will Buster learn to compromise?
programme.sub-title: The Case of the Girl with the Long Face/The Substitute Arthur

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: After George has a lucky streak, his friends pressure him to wish for a snow day. Can George deliver? Prunella's excited about making the gymnastics team, until she realizes practice starts at 6am! Will she practice or snooze?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Muffy's devastated when she learns her great, great grandmother Mary Alice wasn't royalty, but a common maid. Pressure from his classmates has Arthur doubting his decision to call Buster out during a baseball game.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Rattles's mom starts dating Archie Vanderloo, Rattles finds himself spending time with his twins, but they don’t have anything in common. Arthur offers to babysit so that his parents can enjoy some peace and quiet in the backyard.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Power shifts in the Tibble household when the twins find out Tommy is two minutes older than Timmy. Ladonna's thrilled when Muffy loans her a beautiful recital dress, but a run-in with a painted bench creates a problem.

programme.desc: Business is slow for Mr. and Mrs. Read, and Arthur is concerned. Can he find ways to keep his family in the green? When D.W. saves Tommy and Timmy from a nasty fall, they decide to repay the favor…whether D.W. likes it or not.
programme.sub-title: Arthur Read: Super Saver!/Tibbles to the Rescue!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: School is almost out and Arthur can hardly wait for those lazy summer days by Muffy's pool. Nothing could ruin such a happy time of year, except maybe D.W.'s Spring Pageant! And then D.W. can't wait to test out her new play set!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When a powerful hurricane hits Elwood City, everyone's affected. Ladonna's dad is called up by the Army Corps of Engineers. Muffy relocates to a shelter. And Arthur struggles to reunite lost pets and owners.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Brain's Easter egg hunts are notoriously hard. But this year's might prove impossible if Brain can't remember where he hid the final egg. Then, crazy coincidences have prevented Brain from seeing a meteor shower in person.

programme.sub-title: Arthur's Toy Trouble/Spar for the Course

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Kate and Mei Lin are thrilled to tour the solar system with Pal's cousin, Dr. Yowl. Wally is missing and Elwood City's best detective is on the case. And that detective is…Binky?!?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Aliens, conspiracy theories, the megatoad--Buster believes in everything, until his favorite show gets cancelled for false reporting. Dogs love Arthur! Well, except Carrot Cake. Can Arthur win over this picky pup?

programme.title: Arthur

programme.desc: Carl has agreed to play the accordion for George's puppet show. But his routines are getting in the way of rehearsals. Buster enlists Binky's help to keep him from gorging on delicious Tuvaluna cookies. Will Buster's self-control crumble?
programme.sub-title: Carl's Concerto/Too Much of a Good Thing

programme.desc: Mysterious calls. Superhuman strength. Is Mr. Ratburn secretly a superhero? When Buster and Ladonna bond over a memorable trip to the movies, Arthur feels left out. Has Ladonna taken his place as Buster's best bud?

programme.desc: It's a time of change at Lakewood Elementary as Arthur and Buster move up to 4th grade. D.W. and Bud prepare to enter kindergarten and Muffy and Francine contemplate how spending the summer away from each other will affect their friendship.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When two Croc Bandits have a spat, it's up to Po and Mr. Ping to set things right.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: In an attempt to get out of training, Po buys some enchanted shoes that will heighten his kung fu abilities. Unfortunately for Po, the magical shoes are evil and will soon put him and all those around him in great danger.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po is embarrassed when his dad takes him on a wild goose chase, but it turns out his dad is not so crazy afterall.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Master Mugan from the Garnet Palace decides she needs a new Kung Fu Master, Tigress volunteers. Will the Furious Five be minus one or will Po convince Tigress to return to the Jade Palace?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Po's friend Peng returns to the Valley of Peace, everyone is excited...except for Po. What no one else knows is that Peng is actually evil Tai Lung's nephew. Now Po has to admit to powerful Peng that he is the one who skadooshed his uncle.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: As the annual Winter Festival approaches, Po doesn't have enough money to buy his dad the present he deserves, so he takes a job as a bounty hunter to capture a dangerous escaped convict for the reward. But Po's plan doesn't go as smooth as he hoped.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po takes on the challenge of training a lovable but klutzy member of the Emperor's family. However, will Po's training be enough to protect them both from the evil designs of a traitor in their midst?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: After dealing Taotie yet another humiliating defeat, Po is horrified to learn that the villainous warthog has had a full on nervous breakdown. Po is determined to heal his spirit and Taotie is eager to change his evil ways...or is he?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Po's fake love letter prank on Monkey backfires, the duo's relationship is put to the test in a story of jealousy, betrayal and, yes, even kidnapping.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po is sad when he learns that everyone has been invited to a dinner party except for him, due to his poor table manners. Will Shifu be able to teach Po proper etiquette AND foil the attack of evil Temutai and his army?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Shifu's ex-girlfriend, Mei Ling, visits the Jade Palace, Po decides to try and get them back together, despite the fact Mei Ling is now Shifu's most hated enemy.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po and Tigress must track down and stop a messenger from delivering a scroll that could thrust China into all-out war!

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po and the Furious Five meet their greatest challenge yet: a supernatural creature who is invincible to the powers of kung fu.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po and the Furious Five meet their greatest challenge yet: a supernatural creature who is invincible to the powers of kung fu.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Crane's mom visits the Valley of Peace. Crane reveals to Po that his mom hates Kung Fu so he promised her that he would never have anything to do with it. Crane asks Po and the others to help him keep his secret from his mom.
programme.sub-title: Mama Told Me not to Kung Fu

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: With Po and the Furious Five at each other's throats, Shifu takes them all on a disastrous road trip.
programme.sub-title: The Secret Museum of Kung Fu

programme.desc: When Po is possessed by the ghost of evil Master Ding, it's up to Tigress to save him before Ding can unleash his powers and enslave the Valley of Peace.
programme.sub-title: The Spirit Orbs of Master Ding

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po saves a girl from some bandits, only to learn that she's engaged to be married to the Dragon Warrior

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: During a fight with Tong Fo, Po is struck by lightning, giving him the power to read minds.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Over Po's objections, Shifu calls in a noble Samurai prawn to help take down a villain from Japan.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Shifu suggests Po takes a vow of silence to help him focus, but his plan goes awry when the panda starts an armed conflict by keeping his mouth shut.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: The local thugs love Mr. Ping's soup so much, the noodle shop becomes a villain hangout...with Mr. Ping as their unknowing crime boss!

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
